tool_args.rationale: The short-H responses are positive while the H=20 response is negative, matching the recalled dual-horizon adaptation law and refuting the monotone Arrhenius alternative. Fit its four positive parameters numerically to all observations, then use fresh confirmation to test the fitted forecast.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its H=20 observation is negative, directly supporting the reversal mechanism.
The high-horizon negative response resolves the consequential branch ambiguity more directly than an additional branch probe.
The recalled mechanism is a four-parameter dual-horizon response and the existing observations include both short and target-scale horizons; defer extra sampling pending confirmation residuals.
It cannot explain the observed negative response at H=20 after positive short-horizon responses.
